This is a digital timestamping-service test. It can later prove a SOL to USDC conversion, a merchant payment, and a certificate for one digest. It does not prove a physical purchase or shipping to Thailand.
Choose the read-only demo wallet or connect a wallet before requesting a quote. This panel does not ask for a signature.
Mainnet execution gate is off. Signing and sending stay unavailable.
A conversion signature would approve one SOL to USDC swap for the reviewed input, minimum USDC, slippage, and fee. It does not pay the merchant.
A merchant-payment signature is slot 1 of the sponsored 1.000000 USDC transfer. Slot 0 stays empty for the sponsor. SuperTab does not broadcast that transaction.
Signing and sending stay unavailable while the gate is off. An unresolved attempt stays on this purchase. These actions do not start another swap or payment.
List certificates for this wallet if a purchase response is lost.
This would be signMessage on the store's challenge string. It is not a transaction signature and it does not pay.
The exact bytes are the single-use challenge from POST /api/claims/challenge. SuperTab has not requested that challenge.
This asks DFlow for a Solana mainnet-beta quote into mainnet USDC. It does not sign, send, or add the estimate to a wallet balance. A quote is not a completed conversion.
Network: Solana mainnet-beta. Output mint: mainnet USDC, checked by address rather than by the symbol USDC.
No wallet is loaded, so these are known mainnet mints. The balance is not read and the quote is not a balance.
Mainnet signing and sending stay unavailable. There is no approval button on this quote.

No genuine Solana devnet swap into Circle devnet USDC is available from DFlow. A wrapped-SOL order for that mint returned HTTP 400 route_not_found, including when a cluster=devnet parameter was sent. The order API does not select Solana devnet. Executed conversion remains unproven.
Devnet checkout still uses confirmed devnet balances only. This finding does not start a swap or a new devnet purchase.
